name: Time-Woven Vine Atrium
description: An immense greenhouse where ancient vines have grown through centuries in a single moment, each leaf showing a different season, clocks blooming like flowers among the foliage.
prompt: Massive glass atrium, time-woven vines growing through centuries simultaneously, leaves displaying all four seasons at once — blossoms, green, amber, frost on same branch, antique clocks blooming as flowers with roman numeral petals, golden hour light through glass panes, dust motes dancing, hyperrealistic textures, 8k resolution, architectural photography style
caption: Every leaf a different year. Every flower a frozen hour. 🌿⏳
